note: logsum is a summed log-probability, not a probability on [0, 1]; ece and brier are not meaningful on that scale and are reported as NaN rather than computed on a clipped log score. auroc and auprc are rank-based and mathematically monotonic with the product rule (see test_logsum_is_monotone_with_product), so they match to within floating-point tie-breaking: many episodes share identical per-selection score triples (597 unique product values over 1084 episodes here), and log(a)+log(b)+log(c) vs a*b*c can break an exact tie in either direction without any real change in ranking.
